items.title: Kering stock steadies as Gucci reset lifts earnings
items.summary: German-market financial outlet covers Kering's H1 2026 results: Gucci's Q2 organic decline slowed to 2% versus 5% for H1 overall, framed by management as evidence the brand reset is stabilizing. Group generated 1.8 billion euros of underlying free cash flow in H1; management targets cutting fashion/leather-goods inventory by 1 billion euros between September 2025 and December 2026. Stock traded around 57.06 euros, roughly flat on the day.

items.title: Kering stock trades lower as Gucci's turnaround lifts H1 jewelry growth
items.summary: Companion financial-press piece on the same H1 2026 results, emphasizing that Kering's jewelry division (Boucheron, Pomellato) rose 14% in H1 while Gucci's leather-goods core still posted a 2% Q2 revenue decline, underlining that the group's growth is currently coming from outside Gucci even as the flagship brand's decline narrows.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez Get Married in Custom Gucci Attire
items.summary: Coverage of Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez's August 11 wedding in Cascais, Portugal, where both wore custom Demna-designed Gucci outfits (Horsebit-detail loafers and silver Horsebit accessories) as a tribute to meeting a decade earlier in a Gucci store in Madrid; Demna is quoted calling the commission "incredibly special." A high-visibility celebrity activation generating broad EU entertainment-press pickup.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo & Georgina Rodriguez Share Wedding Photos With Kids
items.summary: Follow-up coverage after the couple shared additional wedding photos on Instagram; the piece details that Gucci itself posted images of the custom shoes made for Ronaldo, Rodriguez and their children, extending the earned-media cycle for the Demna-designed wedding wardrobe into a second week.

items.title: Ronaldo Overshadows First Look of Wedding as Assault Allegations Resurface
items.summary: Critical-angle UK culture piece arguing Vogue's high-fashion wedding coverage (Gucci styling by Demna) backfired: rather than discussing the couture, social media and Reddit's r/Fauxmoi community redirected the conversation to Ronaldo's long-standing sexual-assault allegations, with commenters saying no amount of curated Gucci elegance could offset the unresolved controversy. Illustrates how a brand activation can generate negative-valence public discussion once attached to a controversial ambassador.

items.title: r/Fauxmoi thread redirects Ronaldo-Gucci wedding coverage to assault allegations
items.summary: Community discussion on Reddit's celebrity-gossip board r/Fauxmoi (cited and characterized by FashionTimes UK) shifted commentary away from the Demna-designed Gucci wedding wardrobe toward renewed scrutiny of Cristiano Ronaldo's past sexual-assault accusations, treating the glossy Gucci styling as tone-deaf given his history. Logged as a community-channel item via the secondary source since the live thread itself could not be directly fetched; direction and substance of the discussion are independently corroborated by the FashionTimes writeup.

items.title: Forum Members Review Demna's Fall 2026 Runway Debut as Gucci Creative Director
items.summary: Aggregated PurseForum member reactions to Demna's runway debut: some praised the archival Tom Ford-era references and tailoring precision, while others criticized the styling as derivative or overly commercial and questioned whether it represented a genuine creative reset. Retained for community-channel balance despite being outside the ideal freshness window; no fresher PurseForum-specific writeup was found today, flagged as background rather than a new signal.

items.title: En Italie, pres d'un millier d'employes de Gucci lancent un mouvement de protestation
items.summary: French trade-press account of an Italian Gucci-employee protest movement (roughly a thousand workers) over restructuring and job-security concerns tied to Kering's cost-cutting drive. Retained only as recurring critical-angle labor backdrop still referenced in EU coverage of Kering's Florence workforce tensions; explicitly outside the strict freshness window and flagged as background context, not a new signal.
